# Welcome to Data Platform

Requests for Data Platform arrive in the **DATA-REQ** queue. When
something is on fire, page the team lead.

## Your first week

| Day | Do this |
| --- | --- |
| 1 | Get repository access and run the service locally. |
| 2 | Shadow a queue rotation in DATA-REQ. |
| 3 | Ship a small change through the release pipeline. |

Anything in this guide can be ordinary Markdown: tables, checklists, links.
